title: Volvo FH Powder Coated Hi-Tensile Custom Built Aluminium Road Train FUPS Compliant Bullbar #51
description: Volvo FH16 Series 5 Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train Powder Coated FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Dual Mini centre uprights Radar compatable and dual tow pins. Main channel incorporates factory fitted lights with custom built high tensile aluminium backing plate, weight saving = 80kg. Custom driving light mounts and indicator/parker combination light recessed in outer uprights. Roo Slicers fitted to outer area s for additional protection. Removable Road Train signs with provision for Oversize and Long vehicle signs.
